title: How AI Is Actually Reshaping Mobile Gaming Advertising
summary: Move beyond buzzwords. Discover how AI is actually reshaping mobile gaming advertising through advanced targeting, dynamic creative, and automated workflows.
body_markdown:
The conversation around AI in advertising is easy to dismiss when it stays at the level of buzzwords. The leaders we spoke with were more specific. Each had a distinct view on where AI is creating real change inside mobile gaming — not as a concept, but as a mechanism that's already reshaping how campaigns are planned, targeted, and activated.


The targeting story starts with the data. AI is making it possible to apply a far greater number of dimensions in modeling user behavior than was previously practical, opening up addressability in ways that change who an advertiser can reach.
